rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; f4562 p. 1, line 14: "Special depreciation allowance for qualified property (other than listed property) placed in service during the tax year". Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/asset.deepseek.json; 1,083 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 893 partial records): 1,343 of 2,045 comparisons agree (1,331 of 2,017 in scope); 348 value; 243 candidate-unknown; 95 project-unknown; 15 candidate-refuses; 1 project-refuses. All 348 value differences are on entries where the project's line is not reported (asset.on_19 false, checked for every witness), where the candidate enters zero; spec/spec.md (shown_when): "the values sheet shows the line only when it is true ... The value is computed either way". The Schedule C sums read asset.bonus_2025 filtered by asset.listed (sc.f14, sc.f25_assets), which triage compares separately, so no printed amount differs. Witnesses: classm.asset.1 item_1 placed before 2025 ($2,130.00 against $0.00), classm.asset.2 item_1 listed ($19,315.00 against $0.00). The candidate attaches its refusal gates (asset.screen, asset.outside, asset.listed_low, asset.pct_bad, asset.bonus_mixed, asset.s179_bad) to every helper and printed line, so it reads asset.s179 and asset.bonus_same even for property placed before 2025, and asset.bonus_same for property with bonus_choice none; the interview asks neither there (checked against the full profile's targets on each rebuilt witness), and the source needs neither: i4562 p. 3, Part I: "You can elect to expense part or all of the cost of section 179 property (defined earlier) that you placed in service during the tax year and used predominantly (more than 50%) in your trade or business" (an election only for property placed in service during the tax year) and i4562 p. 7, Election out: "You can elect, for any class of property, to not deduct any special depreciation allowance for all such property in such class placed in service during the tax year". (e.g. classm.f8880.2 without bonus_same.) Its other candidate-unknown records withhold class, cost, pct, screen, listed or placed, which the interview asks of every asset where the base is not refused (exception: generated 20261026/449, a fully recovered asset whose cost and percentage the source does not need, the same model error): representation. The 95 project-unknown records withhold answers only the hidden value reads, or asset.class on reported entries (asked of every asset): representation. The 15 candidate-refuses records are on refusal fixtures (stage14.asset.refuse_listed_low, refuse_pct, refuse_s179_over, refuse_class) or their partials, where the project refuses the same return with the same cited gate on another line: scope; the project-refuses record is the cited asset.bonus_mixed. Project stands.
